Painterly semi-realistic 2D, mid-century diplomatic chamber on the second floor of an old customs house: long green-baize table seen side-on, a stern general in slate-blue uniform with brass epaulettes on the left, a bearded envoy in oxblood robe on the right leaning forward mid-sentence, a single tall window behind showing a river and a distant ridge in late-afternoon amber light, dust drifting through a slanted light shaft, wall clock. A dark subtitle panel shows the envoy's line in large serif Korean. Korean UI text: "사흘째 오후", "어느 낱말로 옮길 것인가", "오해 +1". Visual constraints: the envoy of 케리아 is a fictional-culture diplomat in a plain oxblood wool robe with a simple collar, not styled after any real nation or dynasty (no Qing, Joseon, Ottoman or other recognizable court dress); no Chinese characters, calligraphy scrolls or real-world scripts on the walls; the only named parties are "하란 공화국" (general) and "케리아 왕국" (envoy).

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 narrative game screenshot, climax moment at dusk. Top-down-tilted view of a large parchment treaty on a dark table under a green-shaded brass lamp, flickering warm pool of light, the window behind gone violet. The treaty is laid out in two parallel columns, one per nation, six articles as rows; three rows contain words that differ between columns, each marked with a spreading red ink bleed and a dotted red thread linking the mismatched words; the row currently being read aloud is lit by a golden highlight band. Left side: a small hand-drawn map with a ridge, a river, eleven village dots and two different dashed lines both labeled as the same border, plus two small portrait cards of the delegates, one outlined in red because he is staring at the player. Right side: dark panels with a suspicion bar almost at its red threshold and a numbered ledger of remaining misunderstandings. Bottom: four reading-style choice buttons. Deep plum and umber palette, parchment cream, blood red accents, grain, heavy vignette. Korean UI text: "조인 직전 — 낭독", "메르텐 조약", "남은 오해 3". Text constraints: the two treaty columns are headed exactly "하란 공화국" and "케리아 왕국"; delegate cards read only "하란 · 벨크 장군" and "케리아 · 오르멘 사절"; the signing line reads "메르텐에서" with no year or date; no other personal or place names; the misunderstanding ledger lists exactly three unresolved rows (제1조, 제3조, 제4조), none struck through.
